blindSpots.text: The console reads no Node, so it cannot tell whether replicas share the primary's zone (topology.kubernetes.io/zone); only same-node placement is shown.

synchronous_commit is read from the Cluster's parameters only: a role, a database, a session or a transaction can lower it (local, off), and those commits do not wait for any standby whatever sync_state says.
Positions are the console's last sweep of /pg/status; at a real failure the operator reads the instances itself, and the distance will have moved.

Only this cluster's own standbys (<cluster>-N connected as streaming_replica) are listed. Replica clusters, logical replication walsenders and external base backups are not reported by the instance. The "received" LSN of each standby is the primary's sent_lsn.
The synchronous_standby_names PostgreSQL actually applies is not reported by the instance; sync_state per standby and FailoverQuorum.status (when quorum failover is enabled) are the evidence.
CloudNativePG 1.30 does not report whether synchronous standbys sit in another failure domain.
